mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT ( CHAT_CODE, CHAT_MESSAGE, CHAT_DATE /* M_CODE를 아예 제외하고 인서트 */ ) VALUES ( 'C'||LPAD(SEQ_CHATBOT.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), #{chat_message}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT q_code, keyword, response_msg, img_url, link_url FROM chatbot_quest WHERE #{message} LIKE '%' || keyword || '%' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY LENGTH(keyword) DESC
